note.description: One sentence of at most 25 words: the idea of this week's plan and how it moves them toward their goal.

change.description: Only when `why` is "missed": one sentence of at most 20 words saying what moved or was dropped and why. Otherwise an empty string.

sessions.description: The runs still to do this week, one per day at most, only on dates in `days_left`. Never repeat runs already in `done`.

pace.description: Target pace m:ss per km, from `fit.zones` for this kind.

detail.description: At most 15 words: how to run it.

why.description: At most 25 words: why this run, on this day.
